svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="_C7b30_o28aFoVekDyen" name="Page-1"> <mxGraphModel dx="3096" dy="2192" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': {'fontSize': '20px'}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor C as Client
 participant RL as rateLimiter<br/>(middleware)
 participant Redis as Redis
 participant Ctrl as Auth Controller
 participant Svc as Auth Service
 participant Prisma as Prisma
 participant DB as PostgreSQL
 participant MQ as RabbitMQ

 C->>+RL: POST /v1/auth/register<br/>{ email, password }

 RL->>+Redis: INCR rl:register:per-minute:ip:<ip><br/>INCR rl:register:per-hour:ip:<ip>
 Note over RL,Redis: Lua script — atomic<br/>INCR + EXPIRE
 Redis-->>-RL: counts

 alt over 5/min or 10/hour
 RL-->>C: 429 Too Many Requests<br/>Retry-After: <ttl>
 else within limits
 RL->>+Ctrl: forward request
 Ctrl->>Ctrl: validate(RegisterDto)

 Ctrl->>+Svc: register(email, password)

 Svc->>+Prisma: user.findUnique({ email })
 Prisma->>+DB: SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = $1
 DB-->>-Prisma: rows: []
 Prisma-->>-Svc: null

 alt email already exists
 Svc-->>Ctrl: Conflict(EMAIL_TAKEN)
 Ctrl-->>C: 409 Conflict
 else email available
 Note over Svc: bcrypt hash<br/>cost factor = 12
 Svc->>Svc: hashPassword(password)

 Svc->>+Prisma: user.create({ email, passwordHash, role: customer })
 Prisma->>+DB: INSERT INTO users (...)
 DB-->>-Prisma: { id, role }
 Prisma-->>-Svc: { id, role }

 Note over Svc: JWT signing<br/>access + refresh
 Svc->>Svc: issueTokens(id, role)

 Svc->>+Prisma: refreshToken.create({ userId, tokenHash, expiresAt })
 Prisma->>+DB: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (...)
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack

 Svc->>MQ: publish user.registered<br/>{ userId, email }

 Svc-->>-Ctrl: { accessToken, refreshToken }
 Ctrl-->>-C: 201 Created<br/>{ accessToken }<br/>Set-Cookie: refreshToken (HttpOnly, Secure)
 end
 end
",
